concerns.text: Tasks T020-T022 (US2 Implementation) are marked [P] (parallel-safe) but depend on the artifact `data/primes_1e9.csv` produced by T012. T012 is in Phase 3 (US1), while T020-T022 are in Phase 4 (US2). The [P] tag implies these tasks can run in parallel with US1, but they cannot start until US1's output artifact exists. This violates the 'Producer before consumer' dependency rule.

Tasks T026-T028 (US3 Implementation) are marked [P] but depend on `data/density_measurements.csv` produced by T023 (US2). T023 is in Phase 4, while T026-T028 are in Phase 5. Marking these as [P] suggests they can run in parallel with US2, which is impossible as they consume US2's output. This is a hidden ordering requirement masked by an incorrect [P] tag.

The 'Parallel Opportunities' section states 'Once Foundational phase completes, all user stories can start in parallel'. This contradicts the explicit data-flow dependencies defined in the 'User Story Dependencies' section (US2 needs US1, US3 needs US2). The text should be corrected to reflect that US stories must proceed sequentially or that only independent sub-tasks (like tests) can be parallelized, not the main implementation blocks.
